purpose_zh: 为每一条公告/任务书要求与每一项设计深度条目登记「确切」证据位置：具体章节标题、具体图层文件、具体指标字段、具体图版编号、具体构件与路径编号、具体更新行动编号。此前两个矩阵对每一行重复同一套整包引用，读者无法据此核对任何一条要求。
purpose_en: Registers the exact evidence location for every announcement/taskbook requirement and every design-depth item: the named section heading, the named layer file, the named metric field, the named plate id, the named component and route id, the named renewal action id. Both matrices previously repeated one identical package-wide citation set on every row, which let a reader check nothing.
narrowing_rule_zh: 一行只登记真正支撑该行的引用。宁可少而准，不可多而空。整包引用视为无证据。
narrowing_rule_en: A row registers only the references that actually support that row. Fewer and exact beats many and empty; a package-wide citation set counts as no evidence at all.
invented_evidence_rule_zh: 本记录只重排已存在于本方案内的引用，不新增任何外部证据、批复、权属、预算或专业审查结论。
invented_evidence_rule_en: This record only re-points citations that already exist inside the package. It adds no external evidence, no approval, no tenure, no budget, and no professional review finding.

compliance.note_zh: 生态体系的证据是三个实验室承担三项互不相同的任务，而不是一句总口号；三张任务分工图版与三项公开登记类行动是可核对的落点。
compliance.note_en: The ecosystem claim is evidenced by three labs carrying three different tasks rather than by one slogan; the three distinct-task plates and three public-registry actions are the checkable landing points.

report_sections: 总体设计范围城市更新与控规深度城市设计
用地、建筑规模与拆改留方案
compliance.note_zh: 新型城市形态在本方案里只落到一期可逆范围这一层；三个可逆范围图版说明形态是可撤回的支撑体，而非已批复的建设量。
compliance.note_en: The new urban form is claimed only at the level of a Phase 1 reversible envelope; the three envelope plates show a withdrawable support structure, not an approved development quantum.

report_sections: 蓝绿空间、公共空间与城市风貌
AI 创新生态、人才画像与 AI+ 场景
compliance.note_zh: 高品质以夜间照明段、共享工作间与公开试验记录台三个具体构件成立，不以人才吸引力的整体断言成立。
compliance.note_en: Quality is claimed through three named components — the lit segment, the shared workroom, the public test-log desk — not through a blanket assertion about talent attraction.

report_sections: 三层范围工作框架
统筹研究范围产业与未来城市研究
compliance.note_zh: 统筹研究范围没有官方红线，只有临时工作范围；ISSUE-846 记录了该多边形可能位移。
compliance.note_en: The coordinated-research scope has no official redline, only a provisional working extent; ISSUE-846 records that the polygon may be displaced.

report_sections: 三层范围工作框架
总体设计范围城市更新与控规深度城市设计
compliance.note_zh: 总体设计范围的面积为按临时多边形复算所得，公告面积另行登记，两者差值不掩盖。
compliance.note_en: The overall design area is recalculated from the provisional polygon while the announced area is registered separately; the difference between them is not concealed.

report_sections: 三层范围工作框架
重点区域详细设计
compliance.note_zh: 三个重点区域中只有前两个绘制临时工作范围；大钟寺按 ISSUE-1029 保持非地理参照，图版不画多边形。
compliance.note_en: Only the first two key areas draw a provisional working extent; per ISSUE-1029 Dazhongsi stays non-georeferenced and its plates draw no polygon.

report_sections: 统筹研究范围产业与未来城市研究
AI 创新生态、人才画像与 AI+ 场景
compliance.note_zh: 创新生态在空间上的落点是可登记、可更正、可申诉三张桌子；Ostrom 两条只作治理语境，不指定任何运营主体。
compliance.note_en: The ecosystem lands spatially as three tables — register, correct, appeal; the two Ostrom entries supply governance context only and name no operator.

report_sections: 统筹研究范围产业与未来城市研究
总体设计范围城市更新与控规深度城市设计
compliance.note_zh: 未来城市形态的四个指标全部来自对手工申报候选边的种子化 Kruskal 拓扑与选择不稳定性探针，不代表交通需求、可达性或最优性。
compliance.note_en: All four metrics come from the seeded Kruskal topology and selection-instability probe over hand-declared candidate edges; none of them represents demand, accessibility, or optimality.

report_sections: 总体设计范围城市更新与控规深度城市设计
用地、建筑规模与拆改留方案
compliance.note_zh: 容积率字段保持未知状态，功能布局据此只表达分区意图，不表达已批开发量。
compliance.note_en: The floor-area-ratio field stays unknown, so the functional layout expresses zoning intent only and never an approved development quantum.

report_sections: 总体设计范围城市更新与控规深度城市设计
更新项目清单、实施政策与分期计划
更新行动治理登记表
compliance.note_zh: 更新总体框架由共同证据底账、首批试点与年度重跑三项行动构成闭环；三项均登记为未获授权、未落实资金。
compliance.note_en: The renewal framework closes as a loop through the common evidence base, the first pilots, and the annual rerun; all three are registered as not authorized and unfunded.

report_sections: 交通、轨道、市政与公共服务设施
compliance.note_zh: 轨道与市政接口证据不足（ISSUE-1774），因此本条只登记三条区内无障碍连续路径，不主张任何站点关系。
compliance.note_en: Rail and utility interface evidence is missing (ISSUE-1774), so this row registers only the three area-internal step-free chains and asserts no station relationship.

report_sections: 蓝绿空间、公共空间与城市风貌
任务书补充交付：案例、遗址公园与运营转化
compliance.note_zh: 遗址公园活力带以记忆编纂与遮荫雨水两项行动落地，两者均可撤回、均未获授权。
compliance.note_en: The heritage-park belt lands as two actions, the memory compiler and the shade-and-stormwater segment; both are withdrawable and neither is authorized.

report_sections: 蓝绿空间、公共空间与城市风貌
用地、建筑规模与拆改留方案
compliance.note_zh: 批复限高字段为未知，城市风貌因此只在地面层与遮蔽层表达，不作天际线主张。
compliance.note_en: The approved height limit is unknown, so urban character is expressed only at ground and shelter level and makes no skyline claim.

report_sections: 重点区域详细设计
重点区构件与路径登记表
compliance.note_zh: 必选项逐项对位：构件与路径落在「程序与流线」图版，无障碍连续链、冬季运行与维护配对落在「到达、运行与季节」图版，一期可逆范围落在「可逆模块与剖面」图版，三个片区各有一套。
compliance.note_en: Each mandatory item lands on a named plate in all three areas: components and routes on the program-and-flows plate, the step-free chain, winter operation and maintenance pairing on the access-operations-and-seasons plate, and the Phase 1 reversible envelope on the reversible-module-sections plate.

report_sections: 重点区域详细设计
重点区构件与路径登记表
compliance.note_zh: 众智园承担受控测试与治理验证：停止按键与人工接管岗、公开试验记录台、边界告示与退出口构成可停可退的闭环。
compliance.note_en: Zhongzhiyuan carries controlled testing and governance verification: the stop-and-takeover post, the public test-log desk, and the boundary notice and exit form a loop that can be stopped and left.

report_sections: 重点区域详细设计
重点区构件与路径登记表
compliance.note_zh: AI 原点社区承担临校转换与居民主导更正：登记、更正、申诉三步各有一处实体桌面与一处回执板。
compliance.note_en: The AI Origin Community carries campus-adjacent transfer and resident-led correction: register, correct, appeal each have one physical table and one receipt board.

report_sections: 重点区域详细设计
重点区构件与路径登记表
风险、版权与合规说明
compliance.note_zh: 大钟寺按 ISSUE-1029 全程保持非地理参照与非站点表述：五张图版均不含地图、多边形、指北针、比例尺、出入口、道路、过街、地块、距离，也不含任何站点关系主张；构件之间只表达相邻次序，不表达距离。
compliance.note_en: Per ISSUE-1029 Dazhongsi stays non-georeferenced and non-station throughout: none of its five plates carries a map, polygon, north arrow, scale bar, entrance, road, crossing, parcel, distance, or any station relationship, and the modules express adjacency order rather than distance.

report_sections: 三层范围工作框架
总体设计范围城市更新与控规深度城市设计
compliance.note_zh: 总体概念的空间证据仅到三层范围与用地分区一级，边界为临时工作范围。
compliance.note_en: The overall concept is evidenced only to the level of the three scopes and the land-use partition, on a provisional working extent.

report_sections: AI 创新生态、人才画像与 AI+ 场景
统筹研究范围产业与未来城市研究
compliance.note_zh: 全栈自主创新在本方案里只表达为可受控测试、可人工接管、可公开查阅三项能力，不表达技术路线主张。
compliance.note_en: Full-stack innovation is expressed only as three capabilities — testable under control, takeable over by a person, readable in public — and makes no technology-roadmap claim.

report_sections: AI 创新生态、人才画像与 AI+ 场景
交通、轨道、市政与公共服务设施
compliance.note_zh: AI+ 场景以日常服务链与城市服务柜台的排队次序表达；SCHELLING-1971 在此作为负面护栏，提示涌现可能是分隔性的。
compliance.note_en: AI+ scenarios are expressed as a daily service chain and a service-counter waiting order; SCHELLING-1971 sits here as a negative guardrail, a reminder that emergence can be segregating.

report_sections: 蓝绿空间、公共空间与城市风貌
重点区域详细设计
compliance.note_zh: 本方案不提出朝圣地标造型主张；公共空间证据落在共享工作间、照明遮蔽段与公开记录台三处日常构件。
compliance.note_en: No landmark form is proposed; the public-space evidence lands on three everyday components — the shared workroom, the lit and sheltered segment, the public log desk.

report_sections: 任务书补充交付：案例、遗址公园与运营转化
AI 创新生态、人才画像与 AI+ 场景
compliance.note_zh: 百年京张叙事以一项可撤回的记忆编纂行动承载，不主张任何文物认定或历史结论。
compliance.note_en: The centennial Jing-Zhang narrative is carried by one withdrawable memory-compiler action and asserts no heritage designation or historical finding.

report_sections: 更新项目清单、实施政策与分期计划
更新行动治理登记表
任务书补充交付：案例、遗址公园与运营转化
compliance.note_zh: 长期运营以年度重跑一项行动闭合；重跑需人工授权，本包不指定任何运营主体、预算或任期。
compliance.note_en: Long-term operation closes on one action, the annual rerun; the rerun requires human authorization and this package names no operator, budget, or term.

proposal_sections: 设计依据与资料清单
风险、版权与合规说明
design_depth.note_zh: 现状诊断的可核对内容是缺口本身：三条 issue 分别记录总体范围位移、大钟寺位移与约束图层不全。
design_depth.note_en: What can be checked in the diagnosis is the gap itself: three issues record overall-extent displacement, Dazhongsi displacement, and incomplete constraint layers.

proposal_sections: 三层范围工作框架
统筹研究范围产业与未来城市研究
总体设计范围城市更新与控规深度城市设计
重点区域详细设计
design_depth.note_zh: 三层范围各有一个面积字段与一个几何图层对位，层级之间不混用同一数字。
design_depth.note_en: Each of the three scopes is matched to one area field and one geometry layer; no single number is reused across levels.

proposal_sections: 总体设计范围城市更新与控规深度城市设计
蓝绿空间、公共空间与城市风貌
design_depth.note_zh: 空间结构中的持续与分歧廊道计数来自探针，属于对候选集合的选择稳定性描述，不是对城市运行的测量。
design_depth.note_en: The persistent and disagreement corridor counts come from the probe and describe selection stability over a candidate set; they are not a measurement of how the city runs.

proposal_sections: 总体设计范围城市更新与控规深度城市设计
用地、建筑规模与拆改留方案
design_depth.note_zh: 用地布局为概念分区，覆盖率字段说明其对临时多边形的覆盖程度，不等于批复用地。
design_depth.note_en: The layout is a conceptual partition; the coverage field states how much of the provisional polygon it covers and is not an approved land-use plan.

proposal_sections: 用地、建筑规模与拆改留方案
风险、版权与合规说明
design_depth.note_zh: 容积率与限高两个字段保持未知状态，本条据此登记为待确认控规条件，而非已确定强度。
design_depth.note_en: The floor-area-ratio and height-limit fields stay unknown, so this item is registered as a control condition awaiting confirmation rather than a settled intensity.

proposal_sections: 重点区域详细设计
用地、建筑规模与拆改留方案
蓝绿空间、公共空间与城市风貌
design_depth.note_zh: 体量控制只到地面层与遮蔽层：边界告示、共享工作间、遮盖等候三处构件说明尺度感，不作立面或天际线主张。
design_depth.note_en: Massing is controlled only at ground and shelter level: the boundary notice, the shared workroom, and the sheltered waiting module carry the sense of scale without any facade or skyline claim.

proposal_sections: 用地、建筑规模与拆改留方案
更新项目清单、实施政策与分期计划
design_depth.note_zh: 本包不提出任何拆除；三个片区各一个一期可逆范围，全部登记为可撤回、未获授权、未落实资金。
design_depth.note_en: No demolition is proposed; each area carries one Phase 1 reversible envelope, all registered as withdrawable, not authorized, and unfunded.

proposal_sections: 交通、轨道、市政与公共服务设施
总体设计范围城市更新与控规深度城市设计
design_depth.note_zh: 慢行部分是九条区内无障碍连续路径；轨道与停车缺少观测数据，登记为未完成而非以代理值填补。
design_depth.note_en: The slow-mobility part is nine area-internal step-free chains; rail and parking lack observed data and are registered as incomplete rather than filled with a proxy.

proposal_sections: 交通、轨道、市政与公共服务设施
AI 创新生态、人才画像与 AI+ 场景
风险、版权与合规说明
design_depth.note_zh: 新型基础设施只表达为可维护性：备件与维修位、维修模块、维护员站位，配套零件库行动。管网容量证据不足，不作主张。
design_depth.note_en: New infrastructure is expressed only as maintainability — the parts and repair bay, the repair module, the maintainer station, with the parts-library action. Utility capacity evidence is missing and no claim is made.

proposal_sections: 蓝绿空间、公共空间与城市风貌
交通、轨道、市政与公共服务设施
design_depth.note_zh: 蓝绿与公共空间的深度落在冬季可用性上：三张冬季图版说明遮盖、照明与除雪配对，不以四季均好的笼统说法代替。
design_depth.note_en: Depth in the blue-green and public-space item lands on winter usability: three winter plates carry shelter, lighting, and clearing pairing instead of a general all-season claim.

proposal_sections: 重点区域详细设计
重点区构件与路径登记表
design_depth.note_zh: 三个片区各 5 张图版（中英各出一版，共 30 个成品）、5 个构件、1 个一期可逆范围，内容互不重复；合计 9 条无障碍连续路径，按各片区实有的步行路径登记，不为凑数补足。大钟寺全程非地理参照、非站点。
design_depth.note_en: Each area carries 5 plates — issued as a Chinese and an English raster, 30 files in all — with 5 components and 1 Phase 1 reversible envelope, and no content repeated between them. Nine step-free chains are registered in total, as many as each area actually has rather than a fixed quota. Dazhongsi stays non-georeferenced and non-station throughout.

proposal_sections: 更新项目清单、实施政策与分期计划
更新行动治理登记表
design_depth.note_zh: 十二项行动逐项登记操作角色、维护方、受益者、最受影响群体、指标、拟议目标、停止触发与停止权、回退、实物复原、剩余责任、非数字备用方式、资金状态与未决 D 类关口；均未获授权、未落实资金，且不指定任何具名主体。
design_depth.note_en: All twelve actions register an operator role, maintainer, beneficiary, worst-affected group, metric, proposed target, stop trigger and stop authority, rollback, physical restoration, residual liability, non-digital fallback, funding state, and outstanding Class D gates; all are unauthorized and unfunded, and none names a party.

proposal_sections: 更新项目清单、实施政策与分期计划
风险、版权与合规说明
design_depth.note_zh: 分期以「先证据、后试点、再重跑」三步成立，每步都可停止且可复原；三条参考文献只提供分段承诺的语境，不构成财务评估。
design_depth.note_en: Phasing holds as three steps — evidence first, then pilot, then rerun — each stoppable and restorable; the three references supply staged-commitment context only and constitute no financial appraisal.

proposal_sections: 指标体系、面积复算与合规矩阵
风险、版权与合规说明
design_depth.note_zh: 七个字段各自给出定义、来源图层与计算脚本；ISSUE-1781 要求自定义指标有精确定义，ISSUE-2170 要求方法主要结果在正文可见。
design_depth.note_en: Each of the seven fields carries its definition, source layer, and computing script; ISSUE-1781 requires precise definitions for custom metrics and ISSUE-2170 requires the principal results to be visible in the proposal body.

proposal_sections: 设计依据与资料清单
风险、版权与合规说明
design_depth.note_zh: 两个未知指标字段是本条最直接的证据：它们说明缺资料被保留为未知，而不是被代理值替换。季节性资格记录保持未选用状态。
design_depth.note_en: The two unknown metric fields are this item's most direct evidence: they show missing data kept as unknown rather than replaced by a proxy. The seasonal qualification record stays not selected.
